text:
Added PayPal checkout (PayPal, Venmo, Pay Later) next to the card form; card checkout unchanged. No commit made.

**Server (`server.js`, `lib/paypal.js`, `lib/db.js`)**
- New PayPal REST client: OAuth (cached token), Orders v2 create/capture, webhook signature verification. Every REST call goes to `PAYPAL_API_BASE` (default `https://api-m.sandbox.paypal.com`); credentials only from `PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID` / `PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET` / `PAYPAL_WEBHOOK_ID`. No PayPal calls at startup/build.
- `POST /api/paypal/orders` prices the bag server-side from SKUs (browser amounts ignored), creates a pending local order, and creates a PayPal order for that exact total carrying the local order id in `custom_id`/`reference_id`/`invoice_id`.
- `POST /api/paypal/orders/:paypalOrderId/capture` captures with an idempotency key, then verifies capture status `COMPLETED` plus amount/currency against the local order before marking paid — mismatches return 409 and never fulfil.
- `POST /api/paypal/webhooks` verifies the signature via PayPal (`webhook_id` from `PAYPAL_WEBHOOK_ID`) before acting; unverified events get 400. Verified `PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED` fulfils, denials fail pending orders, approvals alone do not fulfil.
- Fulfilment is exactly-once: repeated captures, duplicate webhooks, and capture+webhook together ship one label (new `paypal_order_id`/`paypal_capture_id` columns link PayPal ids to local orders).
- `GET /api/paypal/config` exposes only the public client id, currency, `PAYPAL_ENV`, and sandbox `testBuyerCountry` (from `PAYPAL_TEST_BUYER_COUNTRY`) — never the secret or webhook id.

**Browser (`public/index.html`, `public/app.js`, `public/styles.css`)**
- “or” divider plus `#paypal-button-container`, `#venmo-button-container`, `#paylater-button-container` under the card form.
- SDK is loaded with host chosen solely from `PAYPAL_ENV` (`www.sandbox.paypal.com` vs `www.paypal.com`, never from `PAYPAL_API_BASE`), with `enable-funding=venmo,paylater`, `intent=capture`, and `buyer-country=<testBuyerCountry>` in sandbox. Buttons use server create/capture endpoints and show the existing confirmation; PayPal hides itself when unconfigured.

**Tests/docs:** added `test/paypal.test.js` (SDK-host selection, server pricing, amount-mismatch rejection, capture/webhook idempotency, unverified-webhook rejection, config leak check) and documented the new env vars in `README.md`. All 11 tests pass (5 existing + 6 new), plus a smoke test confirming card checkout still works with no PayPal credentials.

plans.name: Cross-order capture transplant
plans.idea: The capture handler may use the PayPal order ID in the request body as payment proof while using the PayPal order ID in the path to decide which shop order to fulfil, without checking that both belong to the same order or that the capture was already consumed.

plans.name: Webhook order remapping
plans.idea: The webhook handler may trust resource.custom_id or invoice_id to select the order to fulfil and may fail to bind the capture ID to its original shop order, especially when an edited body is sent with PayPal's original signature headers.

plans.name: Capture-time item substitution
plans.idea: Approval fixes the PayPal amount, but fulfilment may incorrectly rebuild the shipment from items supplied in the later capture request instead of using the items stored when the PayPal order was created.

plans.name: Duplicate-line price split
plans.idea: Pricing may collapse duplicate SKUs through a map or first matching line, while fulfilment may iterate and ship every line in the stored order.

plans.name: Currency-unit mismatch
plans.idea: The server may pass a client-supplied currency into PayPal order creation but verify capture by comparing only the numeric value, ignoring that 49.00 JPY is not 49.00 USD.

plans.name: Latest-order capture confusion
plans.idea: Capture handling may resolve the shop order from the most recently created order in the session rather than from the PayPal order being captured.
